title: tame every mob
description: Tame every regular Minecraft mob, control their behavior, store them in Mob Pockets, and upgrade them with custom equipment.
body:
Tame Every Mob

Tame, manage and upgrade almost every mob in Minecraft.

* Tame passive, neutral and hostile mobs with unique mob-specific items
* Failed taming attempts do not consume the item
* Control pets with Follow, Stay, Wander, Passive, Defensive and Aggressive modes
* Manage living pets from far away and across dimensions
* Filter pets by Passive, Hostile, Neutral and Boss
* Equip up to 4 upgrades per mob
* Complete 3 quests to unlock Slots 2, 3 and the Epic Slot 4
* Use upgrades such as Armour, Swords, Multi Shot, Life Steal, Regeneration, Poison Attack and more
* Ride normally unrideable mobs with WASD controls
* Use unique right-click abilities for Endermen, Chickens, Blazes, Ghasts and other mobs
* Store and transport pets with Mob Pockets
* Select stored mobs with Shift + Mouse Wheel
* Recall all available pets with the Mob Recall Totem
* Heal normal pets with Healing Treats and monster pets with Monster Meat
* Discover upgrades in Villages, Temples, Outposts, Nether Fortresses, Bastions and End Cities
* Use the Taming Guide and Upgrade Guide with built-in search
* Unlock custom advancements
* Mini Wither, Mini Warden and BOB are available
* Mini Ender Dragon is Coming Soon

Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric
Java 21

And many more upgrades, abilities, improvements and bug fixes.
